marta_pm: Quick sync 1: new rollout plan for edge-splitter routing experiment. Need a compact QA + rollout ladder, tenant opt-out, and communication plan.
leo_eng: Outline please 1. I can own infra hooks.
marta_pm: Thinking: shadow -> low-volume split (0.5%) -> regional ramp (5%) -> broad ramp (30%) -> global. Manual gate at 30%. Abort on service health or quality regression.
tonysre: Add hard SLO triggers: if 5xxs per minute > 3x baseline OR p99 latency increase > 100ms for 5m -> rollback. Also require no queue growth > 10% for 10m.
ria_platform: Flag schema idea: single flag `edge_splitter_v1` with fields: `stage_pct`, `region_allowlist`, `tenant_exempt`, `auto_progress` (bool). I can add webhook hooks for metrics.
leo_eng: For A/B: within the active pct, split 60/40 A(old)/B(new) to bias safety. We'll run eval job after 5k requests.
marta_pm: Quality pass criteria: model-level QA score within 0.8% of baseline AND user-facing error <=0.3%. Cost delta < 6% preferred.
tonysre: Who's oncall for rollout window? I will. I'll make an ops checklist for paging thresholds.
leo_eng: Instrumentation: traces must include `edge_variant`, `decision_reason`, `tenant_id`, `route_path`. Emit `edge.cache_hit` metric and `edge.route_latency_ms`.
ria_platform: sample config snippet: ```yaml
flag: edge_splitter_v1
stages:
  - name: shadow
    pct: 0
    duration_min: 120
    mode: shadow
  - name: tiny
    pct: 0.5
    regions: [us-west-2]
    duration_min: 30
  - name: regional
    pct: 5
    regions: [us-west-2, eu-central-1]
    duration_min: 45
  - name: warm
    pct: 30
    regions: [global]
    duration_min: 60
abort_conditions:
  - expr: "5xx_rate > baseline*3"
  - expr: "p99_latency_delta_ms > 100"
  - expr: "queue_growth_pct > 10"
manual_gate_after: 30
tenant_exempt: []
```
marta_pm: Manual gate after warm stage 1: require PM + Eng lead + SRE ack before global.
leo_eng: We'll also add a cache-warm probe that sends warmup hints for top 500 keys in each region during shadow. Fail if miss_rate > 8% over 30m.
tonysre: Escalation play: Stage rollback -> create incident -> notify CS + affected customers list if > 5 tenants impacted.
deploy-bot: Flag draft created: edge_splitter_v1 by ria_platform. Webhook endpoints registered: /integrations/flag-events.
ria_platform: I will enable tenant_exempt defaults for enterprise customers (based on label `sensitive`). Also adding per-tenant force-off api.
marta_pm: Communications: I'll post a short note to #customer-success at warm stage (30%). Also pre-announce to internal #product tomorrow.
leo_eng: Test plan: unit tests, e2e route simulation, 2h shadow traffic run that logs to `index=edge-shadow` and synthetic smoke tests every 5m.
tonysre: Alerts: pager if abort_conditions hit; otherwise slack notify to #sre-ops. Add CPU/GPU util checks: if util > 90% for 5m, abort.
marta_pm: Proposed schedule: shadow tonight 22:00 UTC (2h). Tiny & regional tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Warm on Thursday 14:00 UTC. Global Friday 09:00 UTC after manual gate.
ria_platform: I'll seed the flag and create the runbook URL when draft is live.
leo_eng: Edge case: rollout might shift affinity and impact sticky sessions. Add sticky-session-check probe and pause if session-drop rate >1%.
marta_pm: Good catch. Add to aborts.
tonysre: I'll prepare rollback runbook and a one-click kill switch.
deploy-bot: Reminder set: 1762503600 -> shadow run start.
marta_pm: Owners: marta_pm (PM), leo_eng (eng lead), tony_sre (oncall), ria_platform (flag infra). PM signoff required at manual gate.
leo_eng: acked. I'll put the flag in draft and share perms.
tonysre: ack. prepping oncall rota.
marta_pm: no objections, closing thread unless issues. Thanks everyone :rocket:
